description: Implementation of a CoAP client for Zephyr OS, managing request scheduling, response handling, blockwise transfers, and socket communication.

methods.name: send_request
methods.description: Sends data over socket, handling zero address length.

methods.name: receive
methods.description: Receives data from socket, handling zero address length.

methods.name: reset_block_contexts
methods.description: Resets block transfer contexts in a request.

methods.name: reset_internal_request
methods.description: Resets internal request parameters.

methods.name: coap_client_schedule_poll
methods.description: Schedules polling for a client request.

methods.name: has_ongoing_request
methods.description: Checks if a client has ongoing requests.

methods.name: get_free_request
methods.description: Retrieves a free internal request slot.

methods.name: coap_client_default_block_size
methods.description: Returns default block size based on configuration.

methods.name: coap_client_init_request
methods.description: Initializes a CoAP request packet.

methods.name: coap_client_req
methods.description: Main function to send a CoAP request.

methods.name: report_callback_error
methods.description: Calls user callback with error code.

methods.name: timeout_expired
methods.description: Checks if request timeout has expired.

methods.name: resend_request
methods.description: Resends a request if timeout occurred.

methods.name: coap_client_resend_handler
methods.description: Handles resending expired requests.

methods.name: handle_poll
methods.description: Handles socket polling and events.

methods.name: token_compare
methods.description: Compares response token with request token.

methods.name: recv_response
methods.description: Receives and parses a CoAP response.

methods.name: send_ack
methods.description: Sends an acknowledgment message.

methods.name: get_request_with_id
methods.description: Finds request by message ID.

methods.name: get_request_with_token
methods.description: Finds request by token in response.

methods.name: find_echo_option
methods.description: Checks for echo option in response.

methods.name: handle_response
methods.description: Processes incoming CoAP responses, manages blockwise transfer, and invokes callbacks.

methods.name: coap_client_recv
methods.description: Main receive thread handling incoming messages and polling.

methods.name: coap_client_init
methods.description: Initializes a CoAP client instance.
